summary: Restore file-specific ownership when configPath selects multiple config files in one private directory.

patterns: Config callbacks are synchronous and operate through native contained directories.
constraints: Derive the same native lock name from the selected config basename in both entry points.
Retain asynchronous waiting, synchronous refusal, and callback error identity.
Preserve the public entry points and native ownership protocol. Do not replace file operations with stubs.

milestones.goal: Restore file-specific ownership when configPath selects multiple config files in one private directory.

tasks.description: Restore file-specific ownership when configPath selects multiple config files in one private directory.
test_scenarios: Different config basenames can be edited inside one synchronous callback without a lock collision.
An asynchronous caller waits for the selected file lock while a different file remains writable.
A synchronous caller cannot bypass the selected file lock, and callback errors release ownership.

milestones.qualitative_verification: Confirm the implementation retains descriptor-bound native operations.

success_criteria: Different config basenames can be edited inside one synchronous callback without a lock collision.
An asynchronous caller waits for the selected file lock while a different file remains writable.
A synchronous caller cannot bypass the selected file lock, and callback errors release ownership.

directives.text: Derive the same native lock name from the selected config basename in both entry points.
directives.completion_check: Native acceptance scenarios pass without weakening ownership.
